title: People’s Mañanera October 23
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Mexican Science to Ensure the Availability of Medicines  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum presented the Advisory Council for the Digital
Transformation of the Health Sector, which will use AI to improve the supply
of 3 billion medical supplies and pharmaceuticals per year.

**More Equipment and Staff for the People’s Health  
** With 21 billion peso (US$1.13 billion) investment, 780 pieces of highly
specialized equipment and 20,000 items of mid-range technology were acquired.
Sheinbaum announced further hiring at the IMSS, IMSS-Bienestar, and ISSSTE
healthcare institutions, as well as medical salaries exceeding 39,000 pesos
(US$2,095) monthly.

**Perception of Insecurity at Its Lowest Level  
** The public’s perception of insecurity fell to 58.1%, a decrease of 1.7
percentage points from June, according to the National Statistics Institute
(INEGI). “This is the lowest level since the survey began,” Sheinbaum noted.

**Sovereignty Is Defended and Criminal Responsibilities Are Investigated  
** “We must investigate why foreign agents entered Mexico,” the President
said, in response to the case involving the presence of U.S. agents in
Chihuahua. Sheinbaum revealed that State Governor Maru Campos blamed her
former attorney general for their entry and accused him of corruption and
owning casinos.
